decision: Use the reserved warm H200 for exactly one M=1/16/32 gated-activation-to-dynamic-E4M3 down-projection component ledger. The closest same-stack component completed claim-to-release in 5m43s despite two pre-science launcher repairs, so this 12-minute execution envelope fits the retained lifecycle.

bench.initial_state: Zero GPU memory, zero compute processes, and no claim. The pinned image, checkpoint, and CUDA/JIT caches remain resident.

execution.single_start_helper: Claim with PYTHONPATH=research/factory/src python3 -m grad_research.gpu_pool claim for this project and bench, then run the required_runner_invocation once inside the pinned resident image after atomic hash-verified staging.
execution.staging: Atomically stage only the hash-bound runner, candidate Python/CUDA, component manifest, and component into one guest work directory. Verify every final hash before CUDA.
execution.active_session_contract: If work outlives the researcher response, use one controller-host durable PID owner and publish its PID, start ticks, claim generation, unit path, artifact root, and deadline in active_session last.

scientific_contract.question: Does fusing Gemma 4 gated activation with per-token dynamic E4M3 quantization reduce exact layer-0 down-projection component time at M=32 on H200 while preserving the bound numerical oracle?
scientific_contract.candidate: gemma4_gated_activation_quant_e4m3_kernel feeding the same fp8_scaled_mm consumer
scientific_contract.success: All three numerical rows, candidate-path invocations, and CUDA graph arms pass, and the M=32 candidate component median is below contemporaneous baseline.
scientific_contract.negative: A complete interpretable ledger rejects numerical equivalence, candidate execution, CUDA graph replay, or M=32 timing.
scientific_contract.endpoint_promotion: A positive component may be queued for a later endpoint measurement; this binding authorizes no endpoint.

failure_disposition.decision_bearing_terminal: Retrieve and hash the complete ledger, update STATUS.json, and release with the exact claim generation by 16:35Z.
failure_disposition.recoverable_pre_science: Repair only mutable staging, Docker invocation, path, permission, import, or runtime-adapter glue inside the same claim when the corrected run can still complete by 16:32Z. Do not change scientific bytes or count it as a sample.
failure_disposition.cannot_fit_or_unsafe: Preserve the compact diagnostic and science-start state, release generation-fenced to maintenance by 16:35Z, and do not submit a late arm.

must: Read this binding once and verify its hash, every immutable input hash, the exact $2 reservation, available zero-GPU bench, and watchdog before claiming.
Claim only this bench for only this project by 16:20Z.
Run exactly one valid scientific invocation and retrieve its typed ledger.
Release using the returned exact claim generation by 16:35Z on every terminal path.
must_not: Do not modify the component, manifest, runner, candidate, numerical thresholds, repetition count, shapes, consumer, or runtime image.
Do not rerun the completed norm-FP8 component or any settled endpoint.
Do not call provider lifecycle, create a bench, extend the watchdog, or mutate another project.
Do not claim after 16:20Z or retain a claim after 16:35Z.
